title: Reversible String Codec
commonMistakes: Joining words with a delimiter that can also appear inside a word
Forgetting that an empty word still needs a length prefix
Returning a bare string for an encode operation instead of a one-element list
Decoding by splitting on '#' without reading exactly the declared number of characters
followUps: How would you decode the stream one chunk at a time without storing all of it?
What changes if lengths must count Unicode code points rather than ASCII characters?
How could a version byte support future format changes?
attribution: Original problem by the Base Case contributors.
